concerns.text: No task is tagged or described for Functional Requirement FR‑003 (alignment of LLM‑detected bugs with human‑annotated bugs using location + description similarity).
Functional Requirement FR‑005 (perform McNemar’s test and chi‑square tests) has no corresponding task; T011 is tagged FR‑004 only.
Functional Requirement FR‑007 (frame findings as associational only) is not covered by any task.
Functional Requirement FR‑015 (define “CPU‑tractable” limits) lacks a dedicated task.
Functional Requirement FR‑017 (report LLM‑only recall relative to triangulated ground truth) is not represented in the task list.
Success Criterion SC‑001 (measure bug‑detection rate – precision/recall) is not linked to any task.
Success Criterion SC‑002 (measure severity‑distribution differences via chi‑square) is not linked to any task.
Success Criterion SC‑003 (report variance of F1 across similarity thresholds) is not linked to any task.
Success Criterion SC‑004 (record total runtime for feasibility) is not linked to any task.

Task T006 is incorrectly tagged `[FR‑001]` while it implements the `BugDetection` dataclass; this mis‑tag creates false coverage for FR‑001 and leaves the actual FR‑001 (extraction) only covered by T007.
